annotation_notes: Draft labels; nobody has attested human review. The first 24 cases are mission-baseline-v1, copied unchanged. 40 development and 40 held_out cases were added, all assistant-authored in one session: the held_out split guards against tuning on those cases but is not independent evidence. Scenario text and target IDs are evaluator assumptions, not observed visual ground truth. Schema 2: configured_places lists the place names configured on a case's map and reaches the planner and reviewer as in production; cases without it have none. Contexts use the MissionContext event shape; a few add legacy 'message'/'caption' fields that the current recorder drops, to test model-level robustness. Aliases list the article-free form first, then 'the' and other accepted forms. Change label_status only after real review, recording who reviewed which cases here.
